# Dub

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://dub.co/docs.md)
- [Retrieve analytics](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/analytics/retrieve.md): Retrieve analytics for a link, a domain, or the authenticated workspace. The response type depends on the `event` and `type` query parameters.
- [API Authentication](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/authentication.md)
- [Approve a bounty submission](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/bounties/approve.md): Approve a bounty submission. Optionally specify a custom reward amount.
- [List bounty submissions](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/bounties/list.md): List all submissions for a specific bounty in your partner program.
- [Reject a bounty submission](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/bounties/reject.md): Reject a bounty submission with a specified reason and optional note.
- [Create commission](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/commissions/create.md): Create one or more commissions (custom, lead or sale) for a partner. Commission creation is processed asynchronously. Use the List Commissions endpoint or webhooks to be notified when the commission is created.
- [List all commissions](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/commissions/list.md): Retrieve a paginated list of commissions for your partner program.
- [Update a commission](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/commissions/update.md): Update an existing commission amount. This is useful for handling refunds (partial or full) or fraudulent sales.
- [Delete a customer](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/customers/delete.md): Delete a customer from a workspace.
- [List all customers](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/customers/list.md): Retrieve a paginated list of customers for the authenticated workspace.
- [Retrieve a customer](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/customers/retrieve.md): Retrieve a customer by ID for the authenticated workspace. To retrieve a customer by external ID, prefix the ID with `ext_`.
- [Update a customer](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/customers/update.md): Update a customer for the authenticated workspace.
- [Check the availability of one or more domains](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/domains/check-availability.md): Check if a domain name is available for purchase. You can check multiple domains at once.
- [Create a domain](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/domains/create.md): Create a domain for the authenticated workspace.
- [Delete a domain](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/domains/delete.md): Delete a domain from a workspace. It cannot be undone. This will also delete all the links associated with the domain.
- [Register a domain](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/domains/register.md): Register a domain for the authenticated workspace. Only available for Enterprise Plans.
- [Update a domain](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/domains/update.md): Update a domain for the authenticated workspace.
- [List all events](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/events/list.md): Retrieve a paginated list of events for the authenticated workspace.
- [Create a folder](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/folders/create.md): Create a folder for the authenticated workspace.
- [Delete a folder](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/folders/delete.md): Delete a folder from the workspace. All existing links will still work, but they will no longer be associated with this folder.
- [List all folders](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/folders/list.md): Retrieve a paginated list of folders for the authenticated workspace.
- [Update a folder](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/folders/update.md): Update a folder in the workspace.
- [Introduction](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/introduction.md): Learn how to use Dub's API to programmatically manage resources in your Dub workspace.
- [Bulk create links](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/links/bulk-create.md): Bulk create up to 100 links for the authenticated workspace.
- [Bulk delete links](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/links/bulk-delete.md): Bulk delete up to 100 links for the authenticated workspace.
- [Bulk update links](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/links/bulk-update.md): Bulk update up to 100 links with the same data for the authenticated workspace.
- [Retrieve links count](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/links/count.md): Retrieve the number of links for the authenticated workspace.
- [Create a link](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/links/create.md): Create a link for the authenticated workspace.
- [Delete a link](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/links/delete.md): Delete a link for the authenticated workspace.
- [List all links](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/links/list.md): Retrieve a paginated list of links for the authenticated workspace.
- [Retrieve a link](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/links/retrieve.md): Retrieve the info for a link.
- [Update a link](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/links/update.md): Update a link for the authenticated workspace. If there's no change, returns it as it is.
- [Upsert a link](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/links/upsert.md): Upsert a link for the authenticated workspace by its URL. If a link with the same URL already exists, return it (or update it if there are any changes). Otherwise, a new link will be created.
- [Approve a partner application](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/partners/applications/approve.md): Approve a pending partner application to your program. The partner will be enrolled in the specified group and notified of the approval.
- [List all pending partner applications](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/partners/applications/list.md): Retrieve a paginated list of pending applications for your partner program.
- [Reject a partner application](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/partners/applications/reject.md): Reject a pending partner application to your program. The partner will be notified via email that their application was not approved.
- [Ban a partner](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/partners/ban.md): Ban a partner from your program. This will disable all links and mark all commissions as canceled.
- [Create or update a partner](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/partners/create.md): Creates or updates a partner record (upsert behavior). If a partner with the same email already exists, their program enrollment will be updated with the provided tenantId. If no existing partner is found, a new partner will be created using the supplied information.
- [Create a link for a partner](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/partners/create-link.md): Create a link for a partner that is enrolled in your program.
- [Deactivate a partner](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/partners/deactivate.md): This will deactivate the partner from your program and disable all their active links. Their commissions and payouts will remain intact. You can reactivate them later if needed.
- [List all partners](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/partners/list.md): List all partners for a partner program.
- [Retrieve a partner's links.](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/partners/retrieve-links.md): Retrieve a partner's links by their partner ID or tenant ID.
- [Upsert a link for a partner](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/partners/upsert-link.md): Upsert a link for a partner that is enrolled in your program. If a link with the same URL already exists, return it (or update it if there are any changes). Otherwise, a new link will be created.
- [List all payouts](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/payouts/list.md): Retrieve a paginated list of payouts for your partner program.
- [Rate limits](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/rate-limits.md): Learn about Dub's API rate limits.
- [Create a tag](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/tags/create.md): Create a tag for the authenticated workspace.
- [List all tags](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/tags/list.md): Retrieve a paginated list of tags for the authenticated workspace.
- [Update a tag](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/tags/update.md): Update a tag in the workspace.
- [Track a lead event](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/track/lead.md): Track a lead for a short link.
- [Track a deep link open event](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/track/open.md): This endpoint is used to track when a user opens your app via a Dub-powered deep link (for both iOS and Android).
- [Track a sale event](https://dub.co/docs/api-reference/track/sale.md): Track a sale for a short link.
- [Device data](https://dub.co/docs/concepts/analytics/device.md)
- [Introduction](https://dub.co/docs/concepts/analytics/introduction.md): Learn how to use Dub's Analytics API to build real-time analytics dashboards for your links.
- [Links data](https://dub.co/docs/concepts/analytics/links.md): Learn how to retrieve analytics data on Dub by links, folders, and tags
- [Location data](https://dub.co/docs/concepts/analytics/location.md)
- [Partners data](https://dub.co/docs/concepts/analytics/partners.md): Learn how to retrieve analytics data on Dub by partners, partner groups, and partner tags
- [Referrers data](https://dub.co/docs/concepts/analytics/referrers.md)
- [UTM data](https://dub.co/docs/concepts/analytics/utm.md)

- [Deep link attribution](https://dub.co/docs/concepts/deep-links/attribution.md): Learn how to use deep link attribution to track conversions events with Dub.
- [Deferred deep linking](https://dub.co/docs/concepts/deep-links/deferred-deep-linking.md): Learn how to use deferred deep linking to track conversions and traffic.
- [Migrating from Firebase Dynamic Links](https://dub.co/docs/concepts/deep-links/migrating-from-firebase.md): Learn how to migrate from Firebase Dynamic Links to Dub.
- [Quickstart](https://dub.co/docs/concepts/deep-links/quickstart.md): Learn how to use Dub to create deep links for your mobile app (with native support for React Native, iOS, and Android).
- [Bulk operations](https://dub.co/docs/concepts/links/bulk-operations.md): Learn how to perform bulk operations on links.
- [Introduction](https://dub.co/docs/concepts/links/introduction.md): Learn how to use Dub to programmatically create, update, and delete links at scale.
- [Organizing links](https://dub.co/docs/concepts/links/organization.md): Learn how to associate links with users, campaigns, teams, and other entities within your system.

- [Auth0](https://dub.co/docs/conversions/leads/auth0.md): Learn how to track lead conversion events with Auth0 and Dub
- [Better Auth](https://dub.co/docs/conversions/leads/better-auth.md): Learn how to track lead conversion events with Better Auth and Dub
